edits.original: Field crews still collect vouchers, make no mistake.
edits.reason: The finality interjection 'make no mistake' adds emphasis but no evidence, so it is removed.

edits.original: the change significantly streamlines cell-wall composition analysis
edits.replacement: the change streamlines cell-wall composition analysis
edits.reason: The intensifier 'significantly' is redundant because the 40-minute-to-6-minute figures in the same sentence already carry the evidence.
'Full stop' is a finality interjection that repeats the emphatic work already done by the exclusivity marker 'only'.
The intensifier 'dramatically' is a placeholder for evidence and no supporting figure is supplied, so it is removed.

edits.original: supplemental irrigation dramatically reduces yield loss in dry years
edits.replacement: supplemental irrigation reduces yield loss in dry years
edits.reason: The intensifier 'dramatically' is redundant because the sentence already cites the evidence (yield loss fell from 41 percent to 8 percent).
The intensifying adverb 'profoundly' stands in for evidence without supplying any, so it is deleted.
